why_best: This organic visual melt seamlessly bridges two drastically different dashboard layouts without breaking executive spatial focus during a major state change.
why_bad: A hard cut or simple directional slide would make the transition feel abrupt and cheapen the visual weight of a deep data recalculation.
trap: A near-miss will turn the distortion into a chaotic, video-game-like ripple instead of maintaining clean, purposeful structure during the melt.
